subject: executor, planner: add a smaller context for `ToPB` method (#52369)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: this change introduces `BuildPBContext` (planner/context) and rewires `PhysicalPlan.ToPB` plus executor DAG construction to use it, with per-statement caching via `StatementContext` (Reset clears the sync.Once cache). Verified the new context carries the same session-derived inputs previously used in ToPB/pushdown (TiFlash fast-scan/shuffle batch size, and PushDownContext params match `expression.NewPushDownContextFromSessionVars` behavior). Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; no subsequent fix suggests a correctness/semantics regression from this refactor.
